title: Function-normalized native coefficient-ring reindexing
statement: For a prime l, an isomorphism g:X≅Y of schemes and native locally finite adic realizations R on X and S on Y, there is a RingReindex(l,X,g,R,S) [def-sf-native-adic-reindexing-data]. Its coefficient-ring sheaf isomorphism carries every section to the same locally finite continuous function on the unchanged underlying scheme of the site object. No invertibility or finite-type hypothesis is needed for this coefficient-ring assertion.

source.place: BS 6.8.1--6.8.2 and Remark 6.8.15; explicit coefficient-ring part of lem-sf-adic-reindexing-core.

proof.text: At every site object use the identity equivalence on the ULift of the subalgebra of locally finite continuous functions. The proved sectionRing_mul helper from NativeScalarForgetting and the native adic multiplication formula identify both products with the pointwise product. Addition and restriction compatibility are reflexivity. Thus these identities define a natural isomorphism of ring-valued presheaves. Full faithfulness of sheafToPresheaf lifts it to the ring-sheaf isomorphism. Its functions formula is reflexivity. The delivered Lean proof is complete.
